description: GenThADy is a research project focusing on developing gene therapies to convert the APOE4 allele to APOE3 as a preventive measure against Alzheimer's disease.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Neuroscientist at the Deutsches Zentrum für Neurodegenerative Erkrankungen (DZNE)

funding_summary: The project has been awarded a €150,000 Proof of Concept Grant from the European Research Council (ERC) for the period from June 2026 to November 2027.
inflection_why_now: With the increasing prevalence of Alzheimer's disease and the identification of APOE4 as a major genetic risk factor, there is a pressing need for preventive therapies targeting this genetic variant.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Feasibility: Ensuring the safe and effective conversion of APOE4 to APOE3 in human subjects.
Regulatory Approval: Navigating the complex regulatory pathways for gene therapies, which can be time-consuming and uncertain.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: As a pharmaceutical company, Boehringer Ingelheim could provide valuable expertise and resources in the development and commercialization of gene therapies for neurodegenerative diseases.
Specializing in molecular diagnostics, QIAGEN could offer complementary technologies for the analysis and monitoring of genetic modifications in therapeutic applications.
